```python
import pyautogui, time, os, glob, zipfile, tempfile, shutil, subprocess, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's')
time.sleep(0.7)
pyautogui.hotkey('alt', 'f4')
time.sleep(1.0)

home = os.path.expanduser("~")
matches = glob.glob(home + "/**/Dolch_Sight_Words_Primer.docx", recursive=True)
docx = max(matches, key=os.path.getmtime)

vowels = set("aeiou")
ns = {"w": "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main"}
ET.register_namespace("w", ns["w"])

tmpdir = tempfile.mkdtemp()
with zipfile.ZipFile(docx, "r") as zin:
    zin.extractall(tmpdir)

xml_path = os.path.join(tmpdir, "word", "document.xml")
tree = ET.parse(xml_path)
root = tree.getroot()

for tc in root.findall(".//w:tc", ns):
    texts = tc.findall(".//w:t", ns)
    word = "".join(t.text or "" for t in texts).strip()
    if word and word.replace("'", "").replace("-", "").isalpha() and len(word.split()) == 1:
        color = "FF0000" if word[0].lower() in vowels else "0000FF"
        for r in tc.findall(".//w:r", ns):
            rPr = r.find("w:rPr", ns)
            if rPr is None:
                rPr = ET.Element("{%s}rPr" % ns["w"])
                r.insert(0, rPr)
            c = rPr.find("w:color", ns)
            if c is None:
                c = ET.SubElement(rPr, "{%s}color" % ns["w"])
            c.set("{%s}val" % ns["w"], color)

tree.write(xml_path, encoding="UTF-8", xml_declaration=True)

backup = docx + ".bak"
shutil.copy2(docx, backup)
with zipfile.ZipFile(docx, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
    for folder, _, files in os.walk(tmpdir):
        for f in files:
            p = os.path.join(folder, f)
            zout.write(p, os.path.relpath(p, tmpdir))
shutil.rmtree(tmpdir)

subprocess.Popen(["libreoffice", docx])
time.sleep(1)
```
